en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘If a man were to strike the belly of a woman, so she miscarries whatever was in her belly as dead, so upon him would be the fine of providing a male or a female servant, and (to be) handing over to her’.
